headline_marked: [[MP's throat held at ramdao point]] by stepbrothers for property signing, wife alleges in lawsuit
headline: MP's throat held at ramdao point by stepbrothers for property signing, wife alleges in lawsuit
summary: The wife of BNP MP Nasir Uddin Chowdhury has filed a lawsuit alleging his three stepbrothers forced him to sign property deeds by holding a ramdao to his throat while he was incapacitated by a stroke. A court has ordered a CID investigation into the matter.
details: A lawsuit has been filed in Sunamganj's Derai by Parveen Akter, wife of BNP MP Nasir Uddin Chowdhury, against his three stepbrothers and five others. She alleges they forced her husband to sign property deeds by holding a ramdao to his throat. The court has ordered the Criminal Investigation Department (CID) to investigate the complaint.

According to the complaint, MP Nasir Uddin Chowdhury, 75, was seriously ill and mentally incapacitated due to a stroke at the time of the incident. His stepbrothers allegedly planned to transfer his property to their names, fearing they would be deprived after his death, and to disinherit his two wives and two children.

The incident reportedly occurred on January 25, 2022, when the accused brought two sub-registry office employees, disguised as officials, to the MP's home. When the MP refused to sign the documents, they allegedly held a ramdao to his throat, threatening to kill him if he did not comply. His first wife, Sheli Chowdhury, who tried to intervene, was also threatened.

Parveen Akter later rescued the MP with police assistance and took him to Dhaka for treatment, where he revealed the forced signing. The stepbrothers reportedly apologized and promised to cancel the deeds but failed to do so. Both Sheli Chowdhury and the MP's sister, Shamima Chowdhury, have since passed away.

The accused stepbrothers, including Moin Uddin Chowdhury, a joint convener of Derai Upazila BNP, deny knowledge of the lawsuit and state they will respond legally. This legal battle follows public disputes between the MP and his brothers, with the MP having previously stated he has "no brothers."

headline_marked: [[US pledges $15.5M aid to Colombia]] after 7.4 magnitude earthquake causes widespread devastation
headline: US pledges $15.5M aid to Colombia after 7.4 magnitude earthquake causes widespread devastation
summary: The powerful 7.4 magnitude earthquake struck Colombia on Monday, causing extensive damage and casualties. The US aid will support emergency relief and recovery efforts.
details: The United States has announced $15.5 million in financial assistance to Colombia for emergency rescue and relief operations following a powerful earthquake. The aid comes after a 7.4 magnitude earthquake struck the country on Monday, August 10.

The US State Department, in a post on X, stated that the funds would be used to provide shelter, food, and protection for those affected. It will also support the assessment of the earthquake's damage.

In a statement, the US State Department expressed solidarity with the people of Colombia. They affirmed their readiness to stand by President Abelardo de la Espriella and his government in assessing on-the-ground needs.

The earthquake caused extensive damage across various areas of Colombia, with several buildings collapsing and numerous casualties reported. Rescue operations are currently underway to free those trapped under the debris.

Colombian authorities are also working to deliver emergency food, safe shelter, and other essential assistance to the affected population. The US financial aid is expected to play a crucial role in meeting immediate humanitarian needs and assessing the extent of the damage.
